item.title: "tbish" update on "synthiota" board, jam starting at 1:20
item.description: video upload by todbot "Start at 1:20 for a little fun jam. Got some time to work on "tbish" TB-303 emulator in CircuitPython. This video shows some of the updates. The updates include: new mapped_pot_controller to allow the pots to have different modes sequencer has separate lane for slides so that accent & slide can happen on same step tbish_synth now has 4 different waveforms to choose from
